Problem was a stale go cache, once I Cleared the caches from the GHA actions UI the job works again.

Anyhow I am not re-runing/rebasse yet to leave time for comments first

> ```
> ld: warning: search path '/opt/homebrew/Cellar/gpgme/2.1.2/lib' not found
> ```

FWIW this is the Go build cache being unaware of non-Go changes: it caches a build that refers to a specific library path, and once the library is updated, Homebrew installs it into a different directory. It also happens during native macOS development.
